meaning: Since 14 Nov (Fix 1): the budgets cover what the page loads at start, before anyone opens a topic: the page itself (review.html), the course index (data/bank/<course>/index.gz.json since 16 Nov, counted compressed (gzip as base64 text)) and the image-address manifest (data/assets.json), each on its own and together ('start load'). The published set's own limits (256 MB and 511 files per version, 64 MB and 255 files per publish) are checked by tools/publish_set.py.
